Model Tenancy Act, 2021
Section 4 Tenancy Agreement Mandate No person shall let or take on rent any premises except by an agreement in writing, which shall be informed to the Rent Authority within two months from the date of agreement.
Section 10 Security Deposit Cap and Refund The security deposit to be paid by the tenant in advance shall not exceed two months' rent in case of residential premises, and six months' rent in case of non-residential premises. The security deposit shall be refunded to the tenant on the date of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making deductions, if any, of any arrears of rent and damages to premises.
Section 13 Protection against Arbitrary Eviction No landlord shall evict or dispossess any tenant from any premises except by an order of the Rent Tribunal made on an application filed before it. Landlord cannot cut off or withhold any essential supply or service in the premises occupied by the tenant.
Section 21 Repossession of Premises by Landlord The Rent Court may, on an application made to it by the landlord, make an order for the recovery of possession of the premises on grounds of non-payment of rent, misuse, or breach of tenancy agreement.
